sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 56 x 56 x 200 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Neumann U 67 set page and NU 67 V power supply page (read by a research pass 2026-11-12): the microphone has a 7-pin connector (UC 5 cable) to the NU 67 V supply, which has a transformer-balanced XLR-3 male output and an IEC C14 mains inlet. The Bêta proposal port (xlr3-m mic output) is kept and modelled on the base of the microphone as a stand-in (the real XLR is on the power supply). The lathe profile is an estimate from the outer size (56 x 56 x 200 mm, datasheet, size ok): body, neck and a 56 mm head basket, no photo or drawing opened. Beta-modelled. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
